quarterly_data.quarter: Shinko Electric press release: Accelerating Development of Mass-Production Technologies (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: A four-company joint R&D proposal led by NTT Innovative Devices, with Japan Semiconductor (a wholly owned subsidiary of Toshiba Electronic Devices & Storage), Furukawa Electric and Shinko Electric Industries, and NTT as advisor, was selected (announced October 20, 2026) under NEDO's Post-5G infrastructure / advanced-semiconductor manufacturing technology R&D project to establish mass-production technologies for optical chiplets, the photonics-electronics convergence (PEC) devices for next-generation AI computing (no amount stated). Shinko Electric's role: development of optical chiplet packaging technologies and mass production processes, including in-process inspection technologies. The project aims at more than a tenfold increase in manufacturing productivity compared with current R&D-stage processes, and the participants will establish and evaluate a pilot production line designed for future commercial manufacturing.
quarterly_data.figure: target: more than a tenfold increase in manufacturing productivity vs current R&D-stage processes
